Name: AI_STANDARD_INFO_BANK
Description: Basic AI behaviour for a character: how far and how wide it recognises enemies, its territory, and up to four attack slots with their range, frequency and delay.

Fields.Name: Recognition Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which enemy characters are recognised. In metres.

Fields.Name: Recognition Angle: X
Fields.Description: Angle on the X axis within which enemy characters are recognised. 0 degrees is the current line of sight; upward is positive. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Recognition Angle: Y
Fields.Description: Angle on the Y axis within which enemy characters are recognised. 0 degrees is the current line of sight. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Territory Distance
Fields.Description: Radius of the character's territory. If the recognised player moves beyond this distance, the character returns to its initial position. In metres.

Fields.Name: Threat Rate Before Attack
Fields.Description: Chance of performing a threat action before attacking. 0 to 100.

Fields.Name: Threat on First Recognition
Fields.Description: If ON, the character always performs a threat action when it recognises the player for the first time.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Distance
Fields.Description: Range at which this attack is used. In metres.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Range Margin
Fields.Description: Tolerance around the attack range, so the character does not jitter back and forth near that distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Frequency
Fields.Description: Relative frequency of this attack. 0 to 100.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Action ID
Fields.Description: The type of attack this attack slot is.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Minimum Delay
Fields.Description: Shortest delay from when the attack becomes possible until it is performed. In frames.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Maximum Delay
Fields.Description: Longest delay from when the attack becomes possible until it is performed. In frames.

Fields.Name: Attack 1: Cone Angle
Fields.Description: The attack is allowed when the angle between the line of sight and the direction to the target is within this angle. In degrees.
